description: Use this when the user asks about one specific Horseback activity, camp or event: what it is, programme, for whom and from what age, how long, where, group size, what to bring, FAQ, price and how to sign up. Returns everything the activity page says, the matching price-list rows and the page link. Get the id from get_activities (field id). Do not guess the id - get it from get_activities. noUpcomingDate means there is currently no date - say so and suggest asking about the next one. Present only the programme, variants and prices returned by the tools; do not add elements (e.g. first aid, meals, custom vouchers).

activity.description: Activity id from get_activities, e.g. "spotkanie-z-koniem" or "oboz-jezdziecki-dzieci-mlodziez".

language.description: Language of the returned texts: "pl" (Polish, default) or "en" (English). Use the language of the conversation.
